channel.title: Sierra Leone - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sierra Leone, every source cited.

item.title: Sierra Leone charcoal burning causes deforestation
item.description: The practice of burning wood for charcoal is destroying economic trees and threatening food security, officials say.

item.title: Sierra Leone vice presidents fail to reach presidency
item.description: The constitution grants power, but political appointments sideline vice presidents from leadership.

item.title: Female artisanal miners report sexual violence in Kono district mines
item.description: Women working in diamond-rich pits in Jaiama Nimikor face systemic rape and harassment while struggling to earn a living in Sierra Leone.

item.title: NPHA assesses airport health security
item.description: The National Public Health Agency visited Freetown International Airport to boost surveillance and preparedness.

item.title: Sierra Leone students face withheld exam results
item.description: One in four candidates had results withheld for suspected malpractice, fewer than one in 10 passed English.
